name: Meremoth
overview: Meremoth was a male descendant of Bani, noted in Scripture for having married a foreign wife. His tribal affiliation is not specified in the biblical record. The unique attribute of his lineage highlights a significant moment of intermarriage addressed in the post-exilic community.
namesAndTitles: The name Meremoth means "elevations." It is a proper name recorded in Scripture without indication that it was given directly by God. This meaning may reflect a position of prominence or spiritual aspiration.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture explicitly records Meremoth as a descendant of Bani. Beyond this relationship, no further family connections are documented in the biblical text.
scriptureSignificance: Meremoth's significance lies in his identification as a descendant of Bani who married a foreign wife, a situation addressed in the post-exilic reforms. This detail underscores the community's efforts to maintain covenantal purity and obedience to God's commands during the restoration period. His mention reflects the challenges faced by Israel in preserving their identity and faithfulness to God.
